title: Material3 Interaction Regression Family Split v1
problem: The intermediate Material3 interaction-regression binary still mixed navigation, overlay, choice/action, field, time picker, and plain text input tests, making ownership and focused gates too coarse.

repro.summary: Run the new family-owned binaries separately from the residual interaction-regression binary.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test material3_navigation_interactions --test material3_overlay_interactions --test material3_choice_action_interactions
cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test material3_interaction_regressions

gates.name: material3-family-interactions
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test material3_navigation_interactions --test material3_overlay_interactions --test material3_choice_action_interactions

gates.name: material3-residual-interactions
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test material3_interaction_regressions

gates.name: material3-family-check
gates.command: cargo check -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test material3_interaction_regressions --test material3_navigation_interactions --test material3_overlay_interactions --test material3_choice_action_interactions

continue_policy.notes: Closed after the first family split. Start narrower follow-ons for TimePicker, field-family autocomplete/dropdown, or plain TextInput mechanism ownership.
